source: Round-24 drift-arbiter pre-emptive run on T-03 verify-line spec_gap. THIRD `amend_task` for verify-line clarification (T-01 round 19, T-04 round 24, T-03 round 24). Methodology threshold met: arbiter explicitly recommends builder-prompt amendment ('verify never includes infra-deploy commands') rather than continuing per-task.

spec_gap.gap_description: T-03's verify line says '`firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes` succeeds against the dev project; indexes show as building/built in Firestore console.' This explicitly invokes deploy against shared infrastructure (the dev Firebase project), which violates the round-24 harness convention that infra-deploy is a post-merge human step (not subagent-invoked). Indexes are also forward-only, count against quota, and take minutes to build — a wrong index is a real cost. The gap: the verify line as written would force the subagent to deploy, with no emulator-equivalent named.
spec_gap.suggested_amendment: Amend T-03's verify line to be emulator-only, mirroring the T-04 pattern.

actual_baseline.notes: Arbiter's notes flagged the methodology threshold: 'Third instance of the same pattern (T-01 TDD-vs-structural-verify, T-04 deploy-vs-emulator, now T-03 deploy-vs-emulator). T-03 and T-04 are the same gap class — verify lines authored before the round-24 no-deploy convention was codified. Worth a one-time sweep of remaining foundation/slice tasks (T-05 already hit, but anything else mentioning deploy, firebase use, or shared-project verification) to head off further single-task arbitrations. Methodology candidate: tasks should never name deploy in a verify gate; deploy is always a post-merge human step. Consider adding this rule to the task-authoring template rather than continuing to amend per-task.' This is the EXACT pattern the round-24 T-04 arbiter predicted ('if a third lands') — captured here as PR-B trigger.

notes: Methodology threshold case. Two prior instances of the same gap class: T-01 (TDD vs structural verify, round 19) and T-04 (deploy vs emulator, round 24). T-03 closes the threshold. PR-B should: (a) add a rule to builder.md prompt forbidding `firebase deploy` / `pnpm run deploy:*` invocation in verify; (b) optionally sweep remaining tasks (T-06..T-47) for other deploy mentions; (c) update the task-authoring template (when one exists) to encode 'verify never names a deploy command'.
